title: For an etale morphism the upper shriek is the derived pullback
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-shriek, for an etale morphism f : X -> Y of FTS_S, the lemma asserts that f^! is isomorphic to f^* as functors on D^+_QCoh(O_Y) (statement lines 5043-5048). The proof uses that an etale morphism is flat, syntomic and a local complete intersection morphism by Morphisms, Lemma labelled morphisms-lemma-etale-syntomic and labelled morphisms-lemma-etale-flat together with More on Morphisms, Lemma labelled more-on-morphisms-lemma-flat-lci, and by Lemma labelled lemma-perfect-comparison-shriek it suffices to show f^!O_Y = O_X (proof lines 5050-5056). By Lemma labelled lemma-lci-shriek the object f^!O_Y is invertible; considering the cartesian square with the projections p_1, p_2 and the diagonal Delta : X -> X x_Y X, which is an open immersion by Morphisms, Lemmas labelled morphisms-lemma-diagonal-unramified-morphism and morphisms-lemma-etale-smooth-unramified, one has Delta^! = Delta^* by Lemma labelled lemma-shriek-open-immersion (proof lines 5058-5066). Lemma labelled lemma-upper-shriek-composition gives Delta^! o p_1^! o f^! = f^!, and Lemma labelled lemma-base-change-shriek-flat applied to the square gives p_1^!O_X = p_2^*f^!O_Y, whence the chain f^!O_Y = Delta^!p_1^!f^!O_Y = Delta^*(p_1^*f^!O_Y otimes p_1^!O_X) = Delta^*(p_2^*f^!O_Y otimes p_1^*f^!O_Y) = (f^!O_Y)^{otimes 2}, the second step using Lemma labelled lemma-perfect-comparison-shriek again (proof lines 5068-5085). Since f^!O_Y is invertible, the relation with its tensor square forces it to be O_X. Reducing the functor statement to a computation with the diagonal and then solving an invertible object equation is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
